name: coverage-analyzer
description: Parse coverage.py XML reports (coverage.xml) into a human-readable coverage analysis: total line/branch percent, files with zero coverage, worst-10 ranking, delta vs a stored JSON baseline, and a PASS/FAIL verdict against an optional threshold. Stdlib-only Python script (xml.etree.ElementTree, json, argparse) that closes the loop after test-generator. Triggers: 'coverage analysis', 'coverage.xml', 'покрытие кода', 'процент покрытия', 'coverage report', 'проверь покрытие', 'coverage threshold', 'baseline coverage', 'test coverage check'.
author: best
